title: [storage] How long the disk lasts counts the session backups' reflink-aware growth from their status file, and says when it does not
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/storage.rs (`record`, `Sampler`: the loop's `host.storage` sample), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/storage.rs (`growth_of`, `growth_parts`, `persistent_growth`, `sizes`, `with_free`), crates/spawn-postgres/src/host.rs (`HOST_STORAGE`: the oldest sample carrying each field), web/src/resources.ts (`storageView`), and deploy/session-backup.sh ("status": what status.json holds; `new_bytes`).

This builds on objective 085 (the persistent growth), which is in the tree. 083's "measured from" may be in too; keep it.

The problem (lead-mac, 2026-11-12 17:20, A4). "Days until full" (085) sums the growth of three things: the transcript archive, Claude Code's transcripts and the live database. It leaves out /var/backups/spawn-sessions, where every account's sessions are copied every 15 minutes in versions. On this host's btrfs a version is a reflink copy that shares its data, so the tree's apparent size says nothing about the disk; the tree is root's (0700) anyway. The backup's own status file (0644) already says what the kept versions really cost: `estimated_bytes`, the sum of each kept version's `new_bytes` (deploy/session-backup.sh). The forecast must count that growth, or say that it does not.

Required behaviour.
(a) SPAWN_SESSION_BACKUP_STATUS names the backups' status file. There is no default, so a host or a test that does not name one reads none.
- The loop's `host.storage` sample also records `session_backup_bytes`, the file's `estimated_bytes`.
- A sample whose file cannot be read, or holds no such number, leaves the field out and is still written.
(b) `health.storage.growth_parts` gains `session_backups`, measured exactly as the other parts are:
- this answer's estimated_bytes, less the oldest sample of the last 7 days that carries session_backup_bytes, over the days between, rounded down;
- null without such a sample a day old.
The persistent growth (085) and with it days_left count it.
(c) `health.storage.growth_excluded` lists the parts left out of the sum because their source cannot be read now: ["session_backups"] while no status file reads or the one that reads holds no `estimated_bytes` number (a format change excludes the part, it never nulls the whole forecast), [] otherwise.
- An excluded part is null and is not counted, so the other parts still give the persistent growth and days_left (085's rule, "null while any part is null", applies to the parts that are counted).
- A counted part with no sample a day old is still null, and so is the sum.
(d) web/src/resources.ts `storageView`:
- `lasts` reads "about <days> days at the growth of the archive, Claude Code's transcripts, the database and the session backups" when they are counted, and 085's words when not;
- `lasts_note` is "session backups are not counted" when excluded, null otherwise;
- the Storage card shows the note under the line. Read off a screenshot.
No gate, integrator or deploy step reads any of it.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/097.sh. The world is 085's: archive 12 MiB, projects 1 MiB, workspaces 2 MiB; samples 3 days ago in the old shape, and 2 days ago with the database's size and session_backup_bytes of 36 MiB. A status file says estimated_bytes is 40 MiB. Checks:
- (1) the loop's first sample carries session_backup_bytes 40 MiB, beside 085's fields;
- (2) /api/fleet: growth_parts.session_backups is 4 MiB over 2 days, growth_excluded is [], and the persistent growth is the four parts' sum;
- (3) a serve whose status file is not there: session_backups is null, growth_excluded is ["session_backups"], and the persistent growth is the other three parts' sum, with days_left over it;
- (4) storageView's words for both answers, `lasts_note` among them.
It fails with 1 on 44011cbc (live): no session_backup_bytes, no session_backups part, no growth_excluded, and the old words. Its throwaway is sync/obj-097/throwaway.diff. On the mission's main 87db3071 (083 and 086 landed) with the same change, 097, 083, 085, 065, 084 and 086 pass.
A mutant that keeps an excluded part in the sum fails (3).

For live once this lands (a lead step): set SPAWN_SESSION_BACKUP_STATUS=/var/backups/spawn-sessions/status.json in the loop's and serve's environment. 093's `recoverability.session_backup_status` names the same file. Expect session_backups to be null for a day after the deploy (no sample before it carries the field); the persistent growth and days_left are then null too, as after 085's deploy. The figure appears once the first such sample is a day old. On 11-12 17:00 the status file said estimated_bytes 339,937,868 for one account.

The product reason. The session backups are the one grower written every 15 minutes that the forecast does not see. A forecast that leaves out a grower overstates how long the disk lasts. This counts its true, reflink-aware cost, and says plainly when it cannot. Monitoring only.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (065, 083, 084, 085 and 086 read the storage figures) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour:
- a sampler test of session_backup_bytes (a file, no file, a file without the number);
- a spawn-postgres test, through the real store, that the oldest sample carrying session_backup_bytes is found;
- a serve/storage unit test of the parts, the exclusion (no file, and a file without estimated_bytes) and the sum;
- a web/test case of both wordings and the note.
